gameName: My Very First Games: Nibble Munch Crunch
firstPlayerRule: For the cooperative matching game What Do Animals Eat?, the player who last fed an animal starts by turning over the top animal card. For the memory game Who Eats What?, the player who last petted an animal starts by turning over a card from the center.
clarifications: Both games then proceed clockwise. The booklet also describes free play, which has no turn-order instruction.
